newsitem.title: USA: Canada May spot gas prices ease on milder weather.
newsitem.headline: Canada May spot gas prices ease on milder weather.

text.p: Canadian spot natgas prices for May 1 turned slightly softer Monday to meet the swing market as milder weather erased some demand, sources said.

Both May and April gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta was talked at C$1.74 and C$1.75 per gigajoule (GJ), down about four cents from Friday's levels but still about 25 cents higher than April indices.
Temperatures in Calgary are forecast to reach a high of 13 degrees Celsius today following a cooler-than-normal weekend.
Summer AECO prices were quoted at C$1.70-1.72, while November/March was talked around C$1.91.
